design_notes.protocol_adapter: The engine is separated from the wire format by a ProtocolAdapter seam. JSON-per-line is the local-test default; a TSV adapter is a placeholder. When the official driver is published only that layer changes.
design_notes.no_steal_invariant: Data pages are written only at checkpoint; during execution all uncommitted state is in memory. A segment append happens only after the WAL fdatasync, so the segment never contains uncommitted rows.

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Proposed a 10-line plan (C++20 single-thread, WAL+snapshot, undo transactions, exact L2 TopK, IVF later) and flagged three risks: unknown driver protocol, crash-recovery edges, and the memory-limit case. Asked the student to explain three semantics before any code.

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content: ① 过滤后 TopK：执行顺序必须是 WHERE，候选集S，只在 S 上算 L2 ，排序 ， LIMIT。 所以 S 有 3 行并且LIMIT 10 时返回 3 行。S 为空返回空。 "先取全局 Top10 再过滤"错在它先选出了 10 条 skip，过滤后只剩 0 条，就是谓词没有下推到候选集。 并列 1.0 时按主键升序。 正确性判据：结果必须等于"对 S 里每一行都算距离再排序"的暴力结果。

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content: ② 事务内可见性：读路径=已提交基线叠加事务私有写集（read-your-writes）。 语句失败只撤销这条语句的写（语句级 savepoint），但是事务还是继续。所以UPDATE 还在。 ROLLBACK 撤销整个事务的私有写。 没有 BEGIN 时每条语句自成事务，语句成功即提交，对下一条语句可见。

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content: ③ 崩溃恢复边界：承诺的边界是 COMMIT 返回成功的那一刻，返回成功 必须已经 fsync 到日志。 fsync 之前被 kill -9，重启后该事务可以不存在，返回成功之后必须存在。 WAL 尾部半条记录：按长度/校验和识别，截断丢弃。 恢复途中再被 kill：恢复必须可重入/幂等。 未提交的修改可能已经落到数据页，但恢复时不能让它部分可见。

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Implemented the engine, WAL (length+CRC32+COMMIT), snapshot checkpoint, undo-based transactions. Public package went 12/13 then 20/20 after fixing a missing operator assignment in WHERE parsing; the bug was isolated with a parse-only debug probe.

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Asked two transfer questions: (A) a half-written COMMIT record at the WAL tail, (B) a crash after the snapshot rename but before WAL truncation.

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content: A: 扫到第一条 CRC 失败的记录就停…该事务算未提交（presumed abort），进 loser 列表按 prevLSN 回滚（STEAL 下脏页可能已刷盘，不能只跳过 redo），然后把日志截到最后一条有效记录边界并持久化新终点。不能"尽量恢复"的原因：COMMIT 是原子决策点…恢复必须确定性，启发式会让副本分叉。

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content: B: 这是安全侧窗口：快照已落盘，WAL 只是超集…幂等 redo 为什么能兜住：快照 LSN、checkpoint 记录、截断点是三个独立的持久化写，不可能原子…不幂等会怎样：balance += 100 重放两次变 200…B+ 树 split 重放两次直接结构损坏。

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Correct in the ARIES frame, but this implementation is NO-STEAL: data pages are only written at checkpoint, so uncommitted rows never reach the segment and no loser rollback/CLR is needed. Pointed out the ordering nuance: ARIES writes CLRs, so the torn tail is truncated first and undo comes after.

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Implemented the large-data path: append-only cold segments under /data, pk->offset index in memory, tombstones for deletes, compaction at checkpoint. Three bugs surfaced only under forced spilling: order cleared on spill, tombstones not persisted, duplicate order entries on rollback.

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Pushed branch 2026-competition-round2 to the team fork and verified by sparse-cloning it and building from scratch: public package 20/20.

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Added spec edge-case tests (NaN/Inf/overflow rejection, VARCHAR by code points, LIMIT 0, tie ordering, atomicity, transactions, restart). Found a real parser bug: -9223372036854775808 was rejected because the sign was applied after parsing the positive magnitude; fixed by parsing sign and digits together.

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content: 我们的记录格式是 [len][payload]。从头顺序读取scanSegment 先读 4 字节长度，读不满就停止；再读 len 字节，读不满也停止，如果len 大得离谱按垃圾数据停止。扫描结束后，文件只留最后一条完整记录的末尾，因此偏移表不会指向撕裂区。另外这样不会丢已提交行，因为段追加只发生在该行 WAL 的 COMMIT 记录 fdatasync 之后：如果发生撕裂，说明进程是在 WAL 落盘后、段写完前被杀，这时 WAL 里有完整提交记录，重启回放会把这行放回内存，下次落段再写一遍。其中段文件只是已提交状态的缓存， checkpoint 截断 WAL 之前，WAL 才是权威副本。
conversations.note: final wording by the student, edited from the agent's draft

conversations.speaker: student
conversations.content:
顺序是：compact 写 tmp ， fdatasync ， rename ， fsync 目录 →，写快照 ， 截断 WAL。

kill 在 rename 之前情况：旧段完好，tmp 是垃圾文件，WAL 没被截断，重启后用旧段并回放 WAL。
kill 在 rename 之后、截断之前情况：新段已经完整持久（fsync 在 rename 之前完成），但是快照可能还是旧的， WAL 是超集。如果回放 WAL 是整行 after-image，是幂等的，重复应用结果不变。
如果反过来先截断 WAL 再做 compact 是不行：WAL 是 checkpoint 之前唯一的权威副本，如果 compact 中途崩溃，已提交的行既不在段里也不在 WAL 里，会直接丢数据。所以必须“新状态完整可见之后，才能丢弃旧日志”。另外用 rename 避免半新半旧的段文件被当成有效状态。
conversations.note: final wording by the student, edited from the agent's draft

conversations.speaker: teammate
conversations.content: Implemented the JSONL stdio protocol from the round-2 protocol reference: {"type":"ready"} handshake before the first request, {id, op, sql, search_mode} requests, {id, ok, columns/rows | affected_rows | error} responses, and the shutdown op. Added STDIO_PROTOCOL.md, a GitHub Actions validation workflow, and moved the local harnesses to JSONL.

conversations.speaker: agent
conversations.content: Reviewed the protocol against STDIO_PROTOCOL.md with an independent conformance test. Found a deterministic deadlock: poll(fd)+getline can block after iostream reads ahead, so a pipelined batch answers only the first request. Replaced it with raw read()+line splitting; conformance now passes including a 3-request pipelined batch and a shutdown that exits 0 with no extra stdout. Also migrated the remaining harnesses (edge cases, checkpoint fault injection, large recovery, graceful shutdown, fuzz) to JSONL.

retrospective.notes: The student drove constraint discovery (language, submission route) and restated the three core semantics before code existed. The ARIES-style answer for the torn-COMMIT case was correct in isolation but assumed steal/no-force page flushing, which this implementation does not use; that gap is the most valuable recorded discussion because it ties theory to the concrete design.

limitations: The hidden formal driver and hidden inputs remain unavailable; the protocol is implemented from the round-2 protocol reference (STDIO_PROTOCOL.md in this repo) and verified locally, including pipelined input.
ANN mode uses the exact scan, so recall is correct but there is no approximate-search speedup.
The primary-key index (pk -> segment offset) stays in memory; a table whose index alone exceeds the memory budget is not handled.

agent_explanations.question: Q1: append 写到一半被 kill -9，scanSegment() 凭什么判断记录不完整、又凭什么保证截断不会丢已提交行？
agent_explanations.answer: 记录格式是 [u32 len][payload]，append 时先写 len 再写 payload。scanSegment 从偏移 0 顺序读：先 pread 4 字节，不足 4 字节说明尾部被截断，停止；再读 len 字节，读不满同样停止；len 超过 1<<28 视为垃圾直接停止。good 记录最后一条完整记录的结束偏移，扫描结束后 ftruncate 到 good，所以 offsets 里不会出现指向撕裂区的条目。不会丢已提交行：append 只发生在该行的 WAL COMMIT 记录 fdatasync 之后。append 被撕裂说明进程在 WAL 落盘之后、段写全之前挂了——WAL 里有完整提交记录，重启回放会把这一行放回 hot 行，下一次溢出或 checkpoint 再重新追加。段文件只是已提交状态的缓存，checkpoint 截断 WAL 之前 WAL 始终是权威副本。
agent_explanations.status: drafted by the agent at the student's request on 2026-11-10; NOT student evidence

agent_explanations.question: Q2: checkpoint 是 compact → rename → 截断 WAL，kill 在 rename 前/后分别怎样？为什么顺序不能反过来？
agent_explanations.answer: 顺序是 compact 写 tmp → fdatasync(tmp) → rename(tmp, seg) → fsync(dir) → 写 snapshot → ftruncate(WAL)。kill 在 rename 之前：旧段完好，tmp 是垃圾（下次覆盖），WAL 未截断，重启用旧段 + 回放 WAL，状态一致。kill 在 rename 之后、截断之前：新段已完整持久（fsync 在 rename 前），快照可能仍是旧的，WAL 是超集；回放 WAL，redo 是整行 after-image、幂等，重复应用结果不变。kill 在快照 rename 之后、截断之前同理。不能反过来：WAL 是 checkpoint 之前唯一的权威副本，先截断再 compact，一旦 compact 中途崩溃，已提交的行既不在段里也不在 WAL 里，直接丢数据；顺序必须是“新的持久状态完整可见之后，才能丢弃旧的日志”。用 rename 而不是原地覆写，是为了避免半新半旧的段文件被当成有效状态。
agent_explanations.status: drafted by the agent at the student's request on 2026-11-10; NOT student evidence
